author: PackRat 🐀
name: HWiNFO Sensor Dashboard
description: A customizable HWiNFO hardware sensor dashboard for CORSAIR XENEON Edge with automatic sensor discovery, live values, rolling graphs, session statistics, per-sensor thresholds, favorites, presets, and layouts tuned for every XENEON Edge size. Requires HWiNFO and the free local PackRat HWiNFO Bridge on Windows.
